scope: SEARCH-03 full snapshot rebuild, incremental cursor catchup, and atomic index alias cutover

endpoints: GET /internal/v1/content/article-snapshots/{snapshotId} (page 1 omits cursor, subsequent pages use nextCursor)
contentSnapshotClient.http410Handling: Marks current candidate job EXPIRED_SUPERSEDED, preserves active serving alias, creates replacement job with new clientRequestId and candidate_generation + 1
contentSnapshotClient.http401Handling: Invalidates cached service token for (knode-content, content:snapshot:read) and retries

tables.search_index_generation: Per-alias active_generation, active_physical_index, cutover_state (NORMAL|CUTOVER_PAUSED|SWITCHING_ALIAS), active_rebuild_job_id, require_cold_visibility_guard, and cutover cache invalidation compensation state
tables.search_article_version_barrier: Cross-generation monotonic max_content_revision and last_visibility floor preventing late pre-cutover resurrection
tables.search_rebuild_job: Resumable rebuild checkpoint and lease state with UNIQUE(active_lock_key) enforcing at most one active rebuild job per alias across instances
tables.search_rebuild_event_log: Rebuild-scoped idempotency log keyed by (candidate_generation, event_id), isolated from active search_event_inbox
tables.search_article_projection: Composite PK (index_generation, article_id) isolating candidate projection from active generation
tables.search_index_task: Composite PK (index_generation, article_id) with immutable target_index binding every worker write strictly to its task generation's physical index

stateMachine.commitBatchAtomicity: All events in a ChangeCommitBatch and the updated incremental_cursor commit in one SQL transaction; mid-batch failure rolls back the full batch leaving incremental_cursor unchanged
stateMachine.zeroGapEventHandoff: CUTOVER_PAUSING sets search_index_generation.cutover_state=CUTOVER_PAUSED under row lock; ContentEventIngestionService rejects online commits with CutoverPausedException without XACKing Stream entries; SearchIndexTaskWorker stops claiming online tasks; FINAL_CATCHUP drains all commits up to observed head strictly after pause; once SWITCHING_ALIAS completes and resets cutover_state=NORMAL, unacked post-cutover Stream events resume on active_generation=candidate_generation
stateMachine.coldArticleProtection: After rebuild cutover sets require_cold_visibility_guard=1, any online PublicArticleEvent for an article without a projection in the active generation and above search_article_version_barrier performs a fail-closed authoritative Content visibility:batch (PUBLIC_SEARCH) check outside the SQL transaction; denied/deleted articles persist a durable hidden version barrier and never enter the new index

atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.preSwitchVerification: Explicit ES refresh of candidate physical index, exact searchable=true/false document count equality against candidate projection, and sampled search-path (_search by ids with version=true) verification of public fields and tombstone field redaction
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.reconcileFirstRecovery: Persists SWITCHING_ALIAS intent and source/target physical indices before ES POST /_aliases (retaining old physical index). On error or crash-restart, queries ES GET /_alias/{alias}: if alias points solely to candidatePhysicalIndex, reconciles forward to activate local generation and cache epoch without duplicate _aliases; if alias still points to sourcePhysicalIndex, confirmed pre-switch failure reverts cutover pause to NORMAL so old alias keeps serving
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.lateOldWorkerIsolation: Workers bind target_index from search_index_task at claim time; late in-flight g1 writes target only g1 and skip active cache epoch invalidation when task.indexGeneration != active_generation
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.cacheEpochHandoff: Advances knode:<env>:v1:search:epoch via SearchCacheInvalidator after alias activation; slow pre-switch queries fail putIfEpochUnchanged and cannot poison new epoch; transient Redis INCR failure leaves CACHE_INVALIDATING and search_index_generation.active_cache_invalidation_status=PENDING for reliable compensation; public search remains DB-independent

verificationBoundary.verifiedInJvm: Loopback HTTP Content snapshot/changes & visibility stubs, stateful loopback Elasticsearch HTTP stub (indices/refresh/alias/_aliases/_search/version=external), H2 MODE=MySQL fresh & SEARCH-02->SEARCH-03 upgrade DDL, simulated Redis Stream & cache epoch stores, and real KnodeSearchApplication Spring Boot context wiring
verificationBoundary.notVerifiedLocally: Live Elasticsearch cluster shard routing/network partitions, live MySQL InnoDB deadlock contention, live Redis Cluster failover, and live knode-content/knode-auth end-to-end integration
